episodes.name: Bubble, Bubble, Oil and Trouble
episodes.overviewEn: Dr. Octopus commits mysterious crimes to steal the world’s oil supply.

episodes.name: Dr. Doom, Master of the World
episodes.overviewEn: Dr. Doom is mind-controlling world leaders to become master of the world.

episodes.overviewEn: The Lizard plots to turn NYC into a swampland with reptiles.

episodes.name: Curiosity Killed the Spider-Man
episodes.overviewEn: The Black Cat has plans to steal the Maltese Mouse & challenges Spider-Man.

episodes.name: The Sandman Is Coming
episodes.overviewEn: The Sandman steals a soil sample from Mars from NASA.

episodes.name: When Magneto Speaks.... People Listen
episodes.overviewEn: Magneto uses a spacecraft to increase his powers & shut the power supply.

episodes.name: The Pied Piper of New York Town
episodes.overviewEn: Mysterio opens a nightclub that turns its patrons into slaves.

episodes.overviewEn: Dr. Doom returns to replace the world leaders with robots to rule the world.

episodes.name: Carnival of Crime

episodes.name: Revenge of the Green Goblin
episodes.overviewEn: Norman Osborn escapes from a hospital & remembers he's the Green Goblin.

episodes.name: Triangle of Evil
episodes.overviewEn: Triangle of Evil led by Stuntman forces Spider-Man to survive deadly stunts.

episodes.name: The A-B-C's of D-O-O-M

episodes.name: The Sidewinder Strikes!

episodes.name: The Incredible Shrinking Spider-Man

episodes.name: The Capture of Captain America

episodes.name: The Doom Report

episodes.name: The Web of Nephilia

episodes.overviewEn: NASA sends a rocket into space, built by Doctor Doom, unaware of his plan.

episodes.name: Arsenic and Aunt May
episodes.overviewEn: Spider-Man catches the relative of the burglar that killed his uncle.

episodes.name: The Vulture Has Landed
episodes.overviewEn: The Vulture kidnaps scientists to gain control of a NASA space probe.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Sub-Mariner
episodes.overviewEn: Kingpin shows crime boss Silvermane a powerful acid developed by his scientist, Dr. Everett.

episodes.name: The Return of Kingpin
episodes.overviewEn: The Kingpin is able to trick Spider-Man into committing a series of crimes.

episodes.name: Under the Wizard's Spell
episodes.overviewEn: The Wizard invites Medusa to New York City to steal a device from the military.
